function single(x: { a: number }) { console.log(x); }
function double(x: { a: number }, two: number) { console.log(x, two); }
function tuple(...items: [{ a: number }, number]) { console.log(items); }
single(...[{ a: 1, b: 2 }] as [{ a: number; b: number }]);
const saved = [{ a: 1, b: 2 }, 3] as const;
double(...saved);
function spreadOverload(options: { a: number }): 1;
function spreadOverload(options: { a: number; b: number }): 2;
function spreadOverload(options: { a: number; b?: number }): 1 | 2 { return options.b === undefined ? 1 : 2; }
const selected: 2 = spreadOverload(...[{ a: 1, b: 2 }] as const);
console.log(selected);
